rationale: Keep the current 9x512 reverse-tail recurrent baseline intact, but remove the late mismatch between training and scoring recurrence. The bulk run still uses the proven staged tail-recurrence curriculum, then the quant-aware endgame switches training to the same full tail-recurrence gains used by final exact evaluation. This spends the final roundtrip/EMA window calibrating the recurrent tail under the exported inference path without changing shapes, validation, tokenizer/data resolution, or artifact size.
title: Quant-Aware Full-Gain Tail Alignment
